pcs.pc_description: check and confirm instructions given, assess if materials received are fit for specified drum operation
conduct all necessary settings and preparation for drum operationin accordance with specifications and workplace standard procedures to meet the quality standards
check quality visually on a continuous basis to ensure standard is maintained
ensure that after soaking the hide is clean, water content of the hide is approximately 65% and absence of salts
ensure the drum operations meets procedural specifications with regard to temperature, time, air quality, water quality, ageing of hides and addition of surfactant
ensure natural oils and proteins are washed out of the hide after liming
ensure covering of limed hides to prevent lime blast and avoid dragging grain down over floor or other surfaces
follow the temperature specifications (Cold water -80F max.) to de- lime the grain before proceeding to warm washing and warm bating at 97F
ensure that in the pickling, the ph-value of the hide is lowered by adding acid and salt to prepare the hide for the addition of tanning agent.
monitor the drum operations till hide has reached a ph-value of about 3 throughout its full width so that it is ready for the adding of the tanning agent
ensure at the end point of bating it leads to mobility and removal ofnatural pigment, thumb print impression and air permeability
make certain that drums are filtered and cleaned at completion of cycles
maintain the continuity of production with minimum interruptions and downtime
maintain the required productivity and quality levels
identify causes of faults and take action to rectify the same to maintain product quality
follow reporting procedures where the cause o faults cannot be identified
pass the processed hides with support of the assistant operator for
leave work area safe and secure when work is complete next process
